# Supreme Engineering Services

> Supreme Engineering Services (SES) provides turnkey MEP (Mechanical, Electrical, and Plumbing) engineering contracting and consultancy based in Indore, Madhya Pradesh, India. Specializing in Fire Fighting & Safety, HVAC, Cold Rooms, Piping, and Electrical Systems for commercial and industrial facilities.

## Overview

Founded with over 30 years of field engineering expertise, Supreme Engineering Services manages full-scope MEP projects from design intent and procurement to in-house fabrication, site installation, and code-compliant commissioning.

- Headquarters: 25, Dilip Nagar, Khajrana, Indore, Madhya Pradesh 452016, India
- Contact: +91 94253 20455
- Email: irshad@supremeengineeringservices.com
- Primary Domain: https://supremeengineeringservices.com

## Core Capabilities

- [Services](https://supremeengineeringservices.com/services/): Comprehensive overview of eight engineering disciplines.
- Fire & Safety: National Building Code (NBC 2016) compliant hydrant networks, automated sprinkler systems, pump rooms, and deluge systems.
- HVAC & Ventilation: Cleanroom positive/negative pressure cascades, chillers, VRV/VRF systems, and custom ductwork fabrication.
- Electrical Systems: HT/LT electrical panels, transformer installations, load balancing, and industrial distribution.
- Cold Rooms & Storage: Controlled atmosphere PUFF panel cold storage engineering and industrial refrigeration.
- Water Purification: Commercial and industrial Reverse Osmosis (RO) plants, softening, and filtration.
- Fabrication: Precision ducting, pipe bridges, and custom structural steel frameworks.
- Solar Power: Industrial and commercial grid-tied and hybrid photovoltaic solar solutions.

- [Projects Portfolio](https://supremeengineeringservices.com/projects/): Verified project delivery log across hospitals, universities, and industrial parks.
